summary: Two demonstrated defects: replay omits two supplied radio questions, and construction rejects the source-supported sqrt(-2). Tested generated mathematics, grading, rendering and packaging passed. Package unchanged; no database writes.

source_analysis.skill: Classify a given number by value and identify every containing set among N, Z, Q, R and C.
reasoning_steps: Simplify an elementary fraction or root when necessary.
Determine the number's membership class and apply the set hierarchy.
Select every qualifying set or the complete membership list.
invariants: Membership follows mathematical value rather than printed representation.
All numbers within this task belong to C.
Supported source prompts, response formats and complete banks must replay.
permitted_variations: Vary values across the five membership classes.
Vary signs, fractions, decimals and square-root representations.
Vary answer-bearing assignments and presentation order while deriving dependent answers and solutions.

findings.reproduction: Run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python -B source_acceptance.py from evidence_root. It exits 1 and identifies both absent source IDs. Minimal case: the complete -18 radio bank has no replay record.
findings.requested_change: Replace the truncated positional replay and fixed radio key with source-indexed parameter and semantic-answer derivation. Replay every supplied prompt, complete bank, correct key and available solution. Retain the strict regression script.

findings.description: Construction rejects sqrt(-2), and sampling restricts negative radicands to perfect-square magnitudes without an instructional justification.
findings.reproduction: source_acceptance.py calls generator.build({"family":"radical","n":-2}), producing ValueError('nonreal replay uses square magnitudes'). Expected: C only, with sqrt(-2)=sqrt(2)i. Results are retained in source-acceptance-results.json.
findings.requested_change: Support bounded negative nonsquare radicands in construction and sampling. Derive the exact imaginary coefficient and synchronized explanation rather than using integer isqrt as the coefficient. Preserve the failing source acceptance test.
